chapters.t: In the beginning was the Word. The Word was with God. The Word was God.
All things were made through the Word. The Word was the light of all people.
The light shines in the darkness. The darkness did not stop the light.
John the Baptist came to tell people about the light. Many people believed in the light.
The Word became a man. His name was Jesus. He lived among us full of grace and truth.
There was a wedding in a town called Cana.
Jesus's mother Mary was there. Jesus and his helpers were there too.
The people ran out of wine for the wedding. Mary told Jesus.
Jesus said, 'Fill the jars with water.' The helpers filled six big jars with water.
Then Jesus said, 'Give some to the master of the wedding.' When the master drank it, the water had turned into wine! It was the best wine!
A man named Nicodemus came to Jesus at night.
Nicodemus said, 'Teacher, we know you are from God. No one could do the things you do unless God was with them.'
Jesus said, 'You must be born again to see God's kingdom.'
Nicodemus said, 'How can a man be born when he is old?'
Jesus said, 'You must be born of water and the Spirit. What is born of the Spirit is spirit.'
Jesus met a woman at a well. She was from Samaria.
Jesus said, 'Give me a drink of water.'
The woman said, 'You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for water?'
Jesus said, 'If you knew who I was, you would ask me for living water.'
The woman said, 'You don't have a bucket and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?'
Jesus said, 'Whoever drinks the water I give will never be thirsty again. The water I give will become a fountain of eternal life in them.'
Jesus came to a pool where a sick man was lying. The man had been sick for 38 years!
Jesus said to him, 'Do you want to be well?'
The man said, 'I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred up.'
Jesus said, 'Get up! Pick up your mat and walk!'
Right away the man was made well. He picked up his mat and walked!
Jesus's helpers were hungry. Jesus had five loaves of bread and two small fish.
Jesus said, 'Tell all the people to sit down.' There were about 5,000 people.
Jesus took the bread and gave thanks. He broke it and gave it to the people.
He also gave them the fish. Everyone ate until they were full!
When everyone was done eating, the helpers picked up twelve baskets of leftover pieces.
Jesus walked on the water!
His helpers saw him and were afraid. They said, 'It is a ghost!'
But Jesus said, 'It is I. Don't be afraid!'
They wanted to take him into the boat. Right away the boat came to land where they were going.
Jesus said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness. They will have the light of life.'
The Pharisees said, 'You are testifying about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.'
Jesus said, 'If I testify about myself, my testimony is valid. I know where I came from and where I am going.'
A blind man was sitting by the road begging. Jesus put mud on his eyes.
Jesus said, 'Go and wash in the pool of Siloam.'
The man went and washed. He came back seeing!
People asked him, 'How were your eyes opened?'
The man said, 'The man they call Jesus made mud and put it on my eyes. I washed and now I see!'
Jesus said, 'I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep and my sheep know me.'
The good shepherd gives his life for the sheep.
The sheep listen to the shepherd's voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
The sheep follow him because they know his voice.
Lazarus was sick. He was the brother of Mary and Martha. Jesus loved them.
When Jesus heard that Lazarus was sick, he said, 'This sickness will not end in death.'
But Lazarus died. By the time Jesus got there, he had been in the tomb for four days.
Martha said, 'Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.'
Jesus said, 'I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me will live even though they die!'
Then Jesus said, 'Lazarus, come out!' And Lazarus came out of the tomb!
Mary poured expensive perfume on Jesus's feet.
She wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the smell of the perfume.
Judas said, 'Why wasn't this perfume sold and the money given to the poor?'
But Jesus said, 'Leave her alone. She did this to prepare me for my burial. The poor you will always have, but you will not always have me.'
Jesus was at a meal with his followers. He got up, took off his coat, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
He poured water into a bowl and began to wash his followers' feet. He dried them with the towel.
He said, 'Now that I have washed your feet, you should wash one another's feet. I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.'
Jesus said, 'Don't let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.'
'My Father's house has many rooms. If that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?'
'I will come back and take you to be with me. That you also may be where I am.'
Jesus said, 'I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'
Jesus said, 'I am the true vine. My Father is the gardener.'
'He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit. He prunes every branch that does bear fruit so that it will be even more fruitful.'
'Remain in me, as I also remain in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you unless you remain in me.'
'As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.'
Jesus was arrested by soldiers.
Peter was with Jesus. Peter cut off the ear of the servant of the high priest.
But Jesus said, 'Put your sword away. Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?'
They took Jesus away to be tried.
Pilate asked Jesus, 'Are you the king of the Jews?'
Jesus said, 'My kingdom is not of this world.'
Pilate said, 'I find no basis for a charge against him.'
But the people shouted, 'Crucify him! Crucify him!'
So Pilate gave Jesus to them to be crucified.
Jesus was taken to a place called Golgotha. There they crucified him.
It was about noon when Jesus was crucified.
Jesus said, 'It is finished!' Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
A soldier pierced Jesus's side with a spear. Blood and water came out.
Jesus's body was placed in a tomb belonging to Joseph of Arimathea. It was a new tomb.
Early on the first day of the week, Mary went to the tomb and found that the stone had been rolled away.
Jesus appeared to Mary! She thought he was the gardener.
Jesus said, 'Mary!' She recognized his voice.
She said, 'Teacher!' and held onto him.
Jesus appeared to his followers. He said, 'Peace be with you!'
Jesus said, 'As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.' And he gave them the Holy Spirit.
Jesus appeared to the followers by the Sea of Galilee. Peter and others were fishing.
Jesus said, 'Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some fish.'
They threw the net and it was so full of fish they could not pull it in!
Peter realized it was Jesus. He jumped into the water to go to him.
Jesus had prepared breakfast for them. He had bread and fish ready for them.
